title: 3 Easy Ways To Make Your First $100
sources: US Federal Trade Commission, consumer advice: 'Job Scams' and 'Business opportunity scams' (promises of easy, fast money with little effort are hallmarks of scams)
Dollar amounts shown are illustrative examples, labelled as such on the end card. No statistics are claimed.

lines.text: Want your first hundred dollars this week?
Forget get-rich-quick tricks, they're usually scams.
These three easy ways actually work.
Step one: sell the stuff you never use,
like old phones, bikes or clothes.
Snap a photo, post it online, and it turns into cash.
lines.caps: Snap a *photo, | post it *online, | turns into *cash.

lines.text: Step two: do small jobs for your neighbors,
like walking dogs or washing cars.
Step three: sell a skill you already have,
like editing videos or tutoring online.
the easiest money is the money you keep, so save some from every job.
Start today, and that first hundred is closer than you think.
